example: Jeg snakker norsk, og i tillegg kan jeg litt spansk.
example_english: I speak Norwegian, and in addition I know a bit of Spanish.

english: to drop by, to pop in
example: Kan du stikke innom meg etter jobb?
example_english: Can you drop by my place after work?

english: to count on, to expect, to assume
example: Du kan regne med at jeg kommer i tide.
example_english: You can count on me arriving on time.

example: Jeg setter stor pris på at du hjelper meg.
example_english: I really appreciate you helping me.

english: to take care of, to look after
example: Det er viktig å ta vare på helsa si.
example_english: It is important to take care of your health.

english: not so simple, not easy at all
example: Det er ikke bare bare å flytte til et nytt land.
example_english: Moving to a new country is not easy at all.

english: to miss out on, to miss
example: Jeg gikk glipp av konserten fordi jeg var syk.
example_english: I missed the concert because I was ill.

english: to be worth it, to pay off
example: Det lønner seg å øve norsk hver dag.
example_english: It pays off to practise Norwegian every day.

english: It's no use, It won't work
example: Det nytter ikke å klage — vi må finne en løsning.
example_english: It's no use complaining — we need to find a solution.

example: Det er rett og slett ikke godt nok.
example_english: It is simply not good enough.
